questions.prompt: Why does the classifier get a tool with an enum parameter instead of answering in free text?
options: Free text is blocked by pi
The answer must be one of sql, k8s, quant or unsure so code can act on it
An enum makes the model cheaper per token
A tool lets the model see the log
questions.explanation: Code needs a name from a fixed set. The enum forces the model's answer into that set.

questions.prompt: A task says "Why is the web pod restarting?". What does the router do first?
options: Matches a rule on pod and sends it to the Kubernetes expert
Sends it to all three experts
questions.explanation: Rules run first and cost no model call. The word pod matches the Kubernetes rule.

questions.prompt: Why does the router write every decision to router/decisions.jsonl?
options: So pi can load the file as a skill
So wrong routing can be found and turned into golden tasks
So the classifier remembers old tasks
Because pi requires a log before it runs an expert
questions.explanation: Each line holds the task, the choice and the reason. A wrong choice becomes a test case for the router.
